“To philosophize is to learn how to die.” — Michel de Montaigne (Q0051)

An English quotation associated with Essays I.20, organized here under death.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Essays I.20, within the Renaissance Humanism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of death, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Michel de Montaigne's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
